items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Did Janice have any steady jobs...', but the interviewee does not mention Janice in his response, nor does he establish a personal connection or relationship with her in the provided text.

ctx.x: Yeah, Peretti was around. I remember seeing him a lot.
Because he and Wellstead worked a lot later. Yes. Right. Did Janice have any steady jobs in this period that you were with him?

Yes. Mostly at the Central Plaza. We used to work there every Friday and Saturday night. And we used to work a few other jobs too. We did, I don't know, we were on the Arthur Godfrey Show. A lot of things like that. Who else was in the band? A guy named Dick Smith on trumpet. He was from the west coast. He was influenced by Bunk mainly. And, well, before I was in the band, there was a clarinet player named Tom Sharpstein, who used to do a very good imitation of George Lewis. And, when I was in the band, the piano…
